trackers.product_line: IAB Tech Lab's Open Measurement SDK, a library apps and ad SDKs build in so measurement companies can check ads were seen
data_collected: when an ad appears on screen, how much of it is in view and for how long
signals for checking invalid traffic and brand requirements
trackers.monetization_model: IAB Tech Lab publishes the SDK for apps and ad SDKs to build in, as an industry standard for measuring ads; measurement companies place tags in ads that collect its signals (IAB Tech Lab).

data_flows.recipient_label: Ad measurement and verification companies whose tags come with the ad
data_flows.purpose: When each ad appears on screen, how much of it is in view and for how long, collected by the measurement companies whose tags come with the ad, to verify it was seen and check for fraud
data_flows.wording: According to IAB Tech Lab's description of the Open Measurement SDK, updated 2025-11-04.

consequences.text: Apps and ad SDKs build this library in, so finding it doesn't show which company's ads the app shows; the measurement companies that receive the signals come with each ad. FinePrint can't see which ones.
